lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Six vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a grid-like distribution posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular spots, forming defined nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges with sharp vertical luminance gradients visible on the upper lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of small-scale high-luminance spots on the pectoral fin surface, transitioning to larger spots towards the fin base.
